content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] [article_no]. I've set up the web server using the [product_name] Web Editor and programmed the logic with [product_name] Soft Comfort—fortunately, it's working. Now I'd like to implement user management on the web server for two or three users. Currently, I can only log in with "Web User." Is it possible to change this? Thank you for your support!
Hi [user_name], welcome to the forum. It's not possible to change the username.
Hello [user_name], thank you for your answer. Is there any way to set up user management? Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: The core concern is the absence of user management options on the [product_name] web server. The user succeeded in configuring access using the existing "Web User" account but wants features for creating, renaming, or handling multiple accounts, which is currently unsupported. This limitation reduces suitability for applications requiring scalable and secure, differentiated access.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to modify the default username and introduce user management capabilities, allowing several unique user accounts on the [product_name] web server.
